I've set the next main batch to three briefs in this order: BT, then s922, then GR. They're pushed to `develop` as 2176ff2d, and the report is at `docs/briefs/architect-task.md.report.md` (`Result: done`).

**What the batch does:**
- **`docs/briefs/bt-build-time.md`** (builder, opus, 100 turns, $20) moves the build-time refusal, the "may not run" check and the default read into `build_eval.nika`. It also makes the Rust `Wall` an alias of the existing Nikaia `CheckWall`. It waits on nothing.
- **`docs/briefs/s922-sha256-env.md`** (builder, opus, 100 turns, $20) builds steps 1-2 of #922: `hash::sha256_hex`, `env::var` and `env::temp_dir` in `std`. It then deletes the four stand-in `sha256_hex` methods in the tools files and calls the new `std` function instead. This brief adds `std` entries rather than moving Rust, but GR needs them.
- **`docs/briefs/gr-grammar-run.md`** (builder, opus, 100 turns, $20) moves the part of a grammar run that builds and runs its parser into a new `grammar_run.nika`. Its first step checks that BT and s922 are on `develop` and stops if not.

**Decisions I took on #922 (no owner question needed):**
- SHA-256 is written out in `hash.rs`. #922 said `sha2` was already a dependency, but it isn't one of `nikaia-std`, which every user program links. `hash.rs` already copies a hash for the same reason, and the official NIST test values check it.
- `env::var` gets no `touches` line. The specification says a missing line means "touches everything", so reading the environment stays in order with every other effect, and no new touch kind is needed.
- I posted both decisions as a comment on #922. Its steps 3-4 stay open.

**Other changes:**
- The b1044 brief didn't belong in the main lane, which holds only moves. I moved it to the bug lane as `bugs/b8-1044-last-view-handed-back.md`, appended it to that lane's `batch.txt`, and added `wip` to #1044 (it now has `ready` and `wip`).
- I filed nothing for b1046's failure (three tests where the two settings disagree, error NK2302 on `places`). It didn't reproduce: one of the three, `a_lent_argument_from_arms_view_and_new`, passed at both settings on the 042cee5d binary. The other two weren't reached before I stopped the run, so CI will settle it.
- I rewrote the State section of `docs/architect.md` with the new batch and what comes after it.

**Needs from the main session:**
- A version raise for b1046. Its changelog line is in the State section.
- A version raise later for s922 steps 1-2, which change `std`.
- Start the three briefs in order with `nikaia run scripts/agent.nika -- <brief>`.

Owner: nothing to decide.
